sources.title: whisper-tiny: Audio-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview whisper-tiny is a 39-parameter Transformer encoder-decoder model from openai trained for automatic speech recognition (ASR) and speech translation. Built on 680k hours of labeled speech data with large-scale weak supervision, the model generalizes across datasets and domains without fine-tuning. sources.title: Whisper Tiny: Compact ASR Model - emergentmind.com
sources.snippet: Whisper Tiny is a compact transformer-based ASR model offering end-to-end speech-to-text capabilities with ~39M parameters and optimized for low-resource scenarios. It enables real-time CPU inference with low RAM usage (<1GB) and supports on-device tasks like confidence estimation and feature extraction.
